why: Songs the library did not hold that Australia put inside a year-end top 25, took to number one, or voted into a triple j all time countdown. Sources: Kent Music Report year-end top 25 1970 to 1987, ARIA year-end top 25 1988 to 2018, ARIA top ten singles 2019 to 2024, Australian number-one singles 1960s to 2024, triple j Hottest 100 of All Time 1998 and 2009, of the Past 20 Years and of Australian Songs. Every song resolved against the iTunes AU store; anything without a thirty second preview clip was dropped. pack_additions go on the END of each pack so the most-known-first order set on 8 September stands.
